issues.problem: Near-duplicate of cy210 一言不发 (both: not saying a word); its meaning line 'even when one should speak up' added a nuance the idiom does not carry
issues.action: Removed; slot replaced by 胡思乱想 hú sī luàn xiǎng, 'to let one's mind run wild with idle or groundless thoughts', lvl 1, tag foolishness

issues.problem: Near-duplicate of core cy117 全神贯注 (full concentration); the two cannot be told apart as answer options
issues.action: Removed; slot replaced by 说三道四 shuō sān dào sì, 'to make irresponsible remarks about others behind their backs', lvl 1, tag speech

issues.problem: Near-duplicate of core cy074 不可思议 (unbelievable); also more a fixed phrase than a chengyu
issues.action: Removed; slot replaced by 半斤八两 bàn jīn bā liǎng, 'both just as bad as each other; six of one, half a dozen of the other', lvl 1, tag appearance

issues.problem: Meaning 'absolutely true, no doubt about it' was indistinguishable from cy363 毋庸置疑 'beyond any doubt'
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'absolutely true, every word of it (of a report or claim)'

issues.problem: Meaning overlapped cy216 千真万确 and did not show the formal register
issues.action: Meaning changed to '(formal) beyond dispute, leaving no room to question it'

issues.problem: Meaning 'no time to lose, let's act now' blurred into cy453 刻不容缓
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'let's not put it off; better get going right away (urging action)'

issues.problem: Meaning overlapped cy274 事不宜迟; it describes the urgency of a task rather than urging the listener
issues.action: Meaning changed to '(of a task or problem) so pressing it cannot wait a moment'

issues.problem: Meaning line 'deliberately to call black white' was unidiomatic English
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'to call black white on purpose, twisting the truth'

issues.problem: Meaning 'worries about things left behind' was vague and missed that the worries hold one back from pressing ahead
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'worries back home or behind one that hold one back'
